 The available secondary literature references the phrase *āsevanapaccaya* strictly as the "repetition condition" within the twenty-four causal relations of the *Paṭṭhāna*, rather than providing specific historical or textual commentary on this *Kathāvatthu* section.

 The text also exhibits extensive internal reuse with standard dialectical sequences found across other *Kathāvatthu* debates, such as the *Paravitāraṇakathā* (Kv 2.4), *Nirayapālakathā* (Kv 20.3), *Parihānikathā* (Kv 1.2), and *Aññāṇakathā* (Kv 2.2), alongside citations in the *Pañcapakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā* and Ledi Sayadaw's *Paramatthadīpanī* [DharmaNexus].
